paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Comparison of the Improvement for 5-digit and 6-digit multiplication with as feedback model
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy improvement over iterations for 6-digit and 5-digit categories. The x-axis is labeled "Iteration" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 9, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)" and uses a linear scale with visible numeric tick labels ranging from 0 to 80, spaced at intervals of 20. The "6-digit" category is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers; it begins at approximately 1% at Iteration 0, rises sharply to roughly 38% at Iteration 1 and 69% at Iteration 2, and then transitions to a more gradual steady upward trend, reaching approximately 94% at Iteration 9. The "5-digit" category is depicted by a solid orange line with square markers; it starts at approximately 2% at Iteration 0, experiences a steep initial increase to roughly 67% at Iteration 1 and 79% at Iteration 2, and then follows a slight, steady upward slope to conclude at approximately 89% at Iteration 9.
